title: Feature request: Design update for circular watch faces - wearos
body:
Since almost all new watches are circular it could be nice to have a watch faces that is made for circular watch faces in wearOS. On a TicWatch it is hard to see the bottom numbers on the graph. The graph should be placed in the middle and not at the bottom. The steps and heart rate numbers has also a odd positions.

Take a look at this site:
[https://www.deebee.it/?p=14896](https://www.deebee.it/?p=14896) 

Maybe someone should reach out to deebee, they have made some updated designs for circular watches.
